scope: Read-only review of Cordis ownership, exact Loader/Fiber state, provider and service realms, root provider uid=0, store epochs, authentication and bounded IPC lifecycle.
Final source/build/evidence digest mapping, real DSH fixture, focused checks, root gate and dry-run package contents; documentation explicitly excludes readiness signing and artifact/quality proof.

limits: This component does not issue HostAttestationReceipt or advance Control Plane. Readiness signing, artifact pins and supervisor generation/request/fence binding are still required.

The HMAC channel authenticates a shared key holder, not kernel peer credentials. This version requires the trusted caller and Host to share an owner identity. It is not hostile same-UID or same-process isolation.
ACTIVE is a Loader/Fiber lifecycle fact, not plugin quality, loaded artifact byte identity or dependency version evidence. Observer-local store epochs do not count unseen intermediate transitions.
The real fixture loads built local Control Plane/Policy entries by file URL, not an npm-installed candidate. No model call, publication, production activation or complete WP16/WP18 cycle is claimed.
Unexpected Host death can leave a stale socket; only the deployment owner may remove it after establishing that the old process/listener is gone.
